newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico outlines costs of support programmes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico outlines costs of support programmes.

text.p: Following is a table of the Mexican Finance Ministry's estimate of the present value cost of supporting banks and other lending institutions affected by crisis provoked by the December 1994 peso devaluation.
The figures were published in the proposed 1997 budget that was presented to Congress on Thursday.

NOTE: UDI's are inflation-indexed units designed to help Mexican debtor's restructure debt. The ADE is a bank support programme as is FOBAPROA. FINAPE is an agriculture support programme and FOPYME is a small and medium-sized business support plan. -- Mexico City newsroom, (525) 728-9507
